message.reasoning_content:
We need to read the facts: Li is a financial audit chief, discovered that station manager Huang embezzled public funds 240+ million, used for personal investment, gambling. Li discovered in 2013, 2014 that there were personal loans, but he did not report in meeting, only privately reminded Huang. Li's work is serious dereliction of duty. The prosecution wants to hold Li criminally responsible. The question: "只针对这部分列出它构成的罪名" i.e., based on this part of facts, what crimes does Li commit? Likely "玩忽职守罪" (neglect of duty) or "滥用职权罪"? Actually, Li failed to report and allowed embezzlement to continue. In Chinese criminal law, "玩忽职务罪" (negligent duty) is for public officials who neglect duties leading to loss of state assets. Also "徇私舞弊罪"? Not exactly. The facts: Li didn't point out problem in meeting, didn't report to leadership, only privately reminded. That is dereliction of duty. So the crime is "玩忽职务罪". Could also be "失职罪"? The official term is "玩忽职务罪" (Article 397 of Criminal Law). So answer: [罪名]玩忽职务罪<eoa>.

Check if any other crimes: Could be "包庇罪"? He didn't report, but didn't actively help. "包庇" requires concealment of crime. He only privately reminded, not reporting. Might be "徇私舞弊罪" if he colluded. Not indicated. So only one crime.

Thus final answer format: - 单个罪名: [罪名]玩忽职务罪<eoa>.
